$comment: 8-Bit Rebellion protocol catalogue. Wire layouts are extracted mechanically from LPServerMessageParser encoders and cross-checked against the decoders. Schema and framing are described in docs/protocol.md.

primitives.string: uint32 big-endian byte length, then the bytes (client encodes UTF-8; send ASCII); no terminator; nil = length 0
primitives.datetime: encoded exactly like string; text is YYYYMMDDhhmmss (14 chars)
primitives.bytes: uint32 big-endian length, then raw bytes
primitives.array: uint32 big-endian count, then count elements of type 'of'
primitives.entity:<Name>: fields of entities[<Name>] concatenated in order, no prefix

fields.name: channelStatus
fields.notes: server->client 0 asks the client to confirm; client answers 1; server->client non-zero with a non-empty session ID in the session field completes the handshake

fields.name: binaryPDUList
fields.notes: each element: uint32 nameLength + message type name + message body (no session field)

STREAM_COMBINED_MESSAGE.notes: No LPBaseMessage playerID header. The client sends all game messages inside this container.

GamePlayerInfoInternal.notes: Not used by any message (local save format).

Item.notes: itemType = itemID / 1000. Server-issued items: realPlayerItemID unique and non-zero, tempPlayerItemID 0.

LPMailData.notes: Not used directly by any message; the Mail.message blob is a serialized mail content object (inferred to be this layout).

MissionData.notes: Not used by any message (local only).

PlayerProfile.notes: status: 3 = available (default for new profiles), 0 = busy (auto-declines IM). gender != 0 is male (inferred). arrayOfBodyPartIndex: comma-separated, element 0 = skin index, then item IDs per slot. apartmentIDList: comma-separated apartment IDs, first = own apartment.

RankEntity.notes: rankID carries a playerID; rankIndex is 0-based.

Request.notes: type 0 IM, 1 friend, 3 poke. Server fills requestID and fromPlayerProfile when relaying.

ACCOUNT_UPDATE.client_handling: Sent after login (UDID/device token update), on email or password change. Always followed by GAME_ID_UPDATE.
ACCOUNT_UPDATE.minimal_server_reply: ACCOUNT_UPDATE_RESPONSE responseCode 0 with the stored account

ACCOUNT_UPDATE_RESPONSE.client_handling: responseCode 0 copies `account` into the local account; listeners get receiveAccountUpdateResponse: (password-change UI).

ACHIEVEMENT_GAIN.client_handling: Achievement 22000-22014 earned; tempPlayerAchievementID counter starts at 0 per launch; achievementValue '-1' or ''.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAIN_RESPONSE.client_handling: Adds achievement to the in-memory list, deduped by tempPlayerAchievementID; responseCode ignored.

ADD_BULLETIN_MESSAGE.client_handling: Post (client throttles to one per 15 s); no reply.

ADD_ITEM.client_handling: Item gained (mission rewards, mail gifts, sync). item: realPlayerItemID 0, tempPlayerItemID = client counter starting at 1 per launch, itemType = itemID/1000.
ADD_ITEM.minimal_server_reply: ADD_ITEM_RESPONSE echoing tempPlayerItemID with a new realPlayerItemID

ADD_ITEM_RESPONSE.client_handling: UPDATE PlayerItem SET player_item_id = real, temp = 0 WHERE temp = tempPlayerItemID. Refreshes the apartment for furniture types.

ADD_LOG.client_handling: Only sent after CREATE_PROFILE_RESPONSE 0 when the IPA Info.plist contains SignerIdentity (piracy report): logType 0, logValue = profileName. Accept and ignore.

ADD_PLAYER_RATING.client_handling: Star bar on a profile (online mode); rating 1-5.

ADD_PLAYER_RATING_RESPONSE.client_handling: 0 'Thanks for rating!' then re-requests GET_PLAYER_RATING_LIST; 1 'Rated Already'; other 'Failed to Rate'.

ALL_BULLETIN_MESSAGE_LIST.client_handling: Newest first; ignored if messageList[0].locationID differs from the open board; merged by timestamp string.

fields.name: apartment
fields.notes: apartmentData = last UPDATE_APARTMENT_DATA blob, or 1 byte 0x00 for empty

APARTMENT_INFO.client_handling: Stops spinner 0 and loads apartment.apartmentData. playerProfileList is unused. (The client also builds one locally offline, hence 'both'.)

BLOCK_PLAYER.client_handling: Adds to local Blacklist then sends; no reply.

BUY_PRODUCT.client_handling: Store purchase with in-game credits (no StoreKit). itemList = the product's items (only itemID/itemType set). Price is not sent; the client deducts credits itself and then sends PLAYER_PROFILE_UPDATE.

fields.name: itemList
fields.notes: the product's items with unique realPlayerItemID, tempPlayerItemID 0

BUY_PRODUCT_RESPONSE.client_handling: responseCode is not read. Inserts each item locally, deducts credits, 'BUY_SUCCESS' popup, stops spinner 2.

CHANGE_LOCATION.client_handling: On every scene entry except the apartment (location 7). Location IDs are listed in protocol.md.

CREATE_ACCOUNT.client_handling: Sent from the account form (createOnlineAccount:isOptin:) and when converting an offline/guest player (createAccount:). account carries userName, password, email, optin, UDID, device info.

CREATE_ACCOUNT_RESPONSE.client_handling: responseCode 0 = created: the client moves its local database to the new user name and sends LOGIN; 1 = 'This name has already been taken by another player'; 2 = 'This email has already been taken by another player'; other = back to form.

CREATE_PROFILE.client_handling: Character creation (CreateProfileComponent confirm, CoreUIPanel). Full profile, status=3, receiveNotification=1. Not sent in guest-reconnect/offline mode (local fake response 0).

fields.name: playerProfile
fields.notes: must carry the new real playerID

CREATE_PROFILE_RESPONSE.client_handling: responseCode 0: playerProfile becomes the self profile and its playerID becomes the client's player ID; client sends GAME_ID_UPDATE (and ADD_LOG if the IPA is cracked). Other codes leave the create screen waiting (no error popup found).

CREW_BATTLE_UPDATE.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

CREW_RANK_RESPONSE.client_handling: Fills the crew rank table (spinner 5). responseCode ignored.

DELETE_ITEM.client_handling: Item discarded/consumed/gifted; playerItemID = local player_item_id. No reply; ignore unknown IDs.

FIGHT_RESULT_LIST.client_handling: FightConnector compares the type and does nothing.

FORGOT_PASSWORD_RESPONSE.client_handling: responseCode 1 -> forgotPasswordSuccess:NO ('this email address has not been registered'), 0 -> forgotPasswordSuccess:YES ('An email has been sent').

FRIEND_PROFILE_LIST.client_handling: Replaces the local Friends table. friendType 0 normal, 1 top friend. friendProfile.status 0 or 3 seeds the online list.

FRIEND_REMOVED.client_handling: Push: removes targetPlayerID (the remover) from the friend tables.

GAME_ID_UPDATE.client_handling: Fire-and-forget after login success, profile creation and every ACCOUNT_UPDATE. gameID is always 4.

GENERAL_ERROR_MESSAGE.client_handling: Logs errorMessage, stops startup, logs out of online features. errorCode 3 shows 'Server Full', 4 shows 'Server Maintenance' (LPBasePanel).

GET_ALL_BULLETIN_MESSAGE.client_handling: Every 30 s while a bulletin board is open and 5 s after posting.

GET_ALL_FRIENDS_PROFILE.client_handling: At startup (online) and from the friend screen.

GET_ALL_PLAYER_ITEMS.client_handling: At startup (online). Inventory shows a spinner until ITEM_LIST arrives.

GET_ALL_PRODUCT.client_handling: Never sent: the store reads lp.sqlite.

GET_BLACK_BIRDS.client_handling: Mission 6: player types an email to receive the 'Blackbirds' mp3. Mission completes regardless.

GET_ONLINE_FRIENDS_STATUS.client_handling: Every 20 s while the friend list is open (sent by requestOnlineFriendsID).

GET_PLAYER_ALL_ACHIEVEMENT.client_handling: At startup with own playerID, and when viewing a profile's trophies.

GET_PLAYER_RATING_LIST.client_handling: On opening any profile; playerRatingList is always [1,2,3,4,5].

GET_PROFANITY_WORDS_ENTITY.client_handling: At startup and during account creation if the word list is not ready.

GOTO_APARTMENT.client_handling: Entering an apartment; apartmentID = first number of profile.apartmentIDList.
GOTO_APARTMENT.minimal_server_reply: APARTMENT_INFO (mandatory when visiting another player or when own data is missing)

GUEST_LOGIN.client_handling: Sent every 20 s in guest-reconnect mode (network mode 2) after an offline profile exists; this is the 'Call connect to server' seen after the character editor.
GUEST_LOGIN.minimal_server_reply: LOGIN_RESPONSE with responseCode 5 (keeps the local profile, enters guest mode) or 0/4 (online mode).

IM_BUSY.client_handling: 'The player is currently unavailable for chatting.'

IM_MESSAGE.client_handling: Out: targetPlayerID = peer, message = opaque IMContentMessage bytes. In: relay with targetPlayerID = the sender and the bytes unchanged; dropped if no room is open.

IM_START.client_handling: Push to both parties after an accepted IM request; targetPlayerProfile = the other party. Opens a chat room (max 2).

IM_STOP.client_handling: Out when the user closes a chat. In: 'The chat with %@ was closed'. Relay with targetPlayerID = the stopper.

ITEM_LIST.client_handling: Replaces the local PlayerItem table; pending local items (tempPlayerItemID != 0) are re-sent as new ADD_ITEMs.

JOIN_CREW_BATTLE.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

JOIN_CREW_BATTLE_RESPONSE.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

fields.name: playerProfileList
fields.notes: other online players in the location; exclude the requester

LOCATION_PLAYER_PROFILE.client_handling: AvatarComponent spawns one static OtherPlayerAvatar per profile (deduped by playerID, self not filtered) at a random x. Dropped in locations 7, 9, 29, 31, 33, 34 and some mission states. No later movement or removal messages exist.

LOGIN.client_handling: Sent by -[AccountConnector loginWithName:Password:Version:] (login form, version=1), loginPreviousAccount (every 20 s in online-reconnect mode, stored credentials). Password is plaintext.

fields.name: playerID
fields.notes: becomes the client's player ID (header of every later message)

fields.name: responseCode
fields.notes: 0 ok, 1 bad credentials, 2/3 fail, 4 ok-no-profile, 5 ok-guest, 6 unknown

LOGIN_RESPONSE.client_handling: Ignored if already logged in. responseCode 0 = success (profile.profileName must equal the login userName case-insensitively, else the client treats it as no answer and the spinner never stops); 1 = 'Invalid Name or Password'; 2,3 = silent return to form; 4 = success, account has no profile yet (create-profile UI); 5 = accepted (guest/keep local profile, runs startup process); 6 = stored only. Codes 0/4/5 store the account and set the header playerID as the client's player ID for all later messages. Code 0 also replaces the local profile with `profile`, then the client sends GAME_ID_UPDATE and (from the login form) ACCOUNT_UPDATE + GAME_ID_UPDATE. Then the offline buffer is replayed.

LOGOUT.client_handling: Server-initiated kick: listeners log out and the client stops the network manager. The client builds a LOGOUT object but never sends it.

MAIL_LIST.client_handling: Shown in list order (send newest first); mail from self shows as 'Jess'; unread mail from blocked players is auto-deleted.

MISSION_STATE_RESPOSNE.client_handling: Missions are local only (type name misspelled in the binary).

NEWS_LIST.client_handling: Media-player news table; created parsed as YYYYMMDDhhmmss; item tappable if link longer than 7 chars.

NEW_BULLETIN_MESSAGE.client_handling: Optional push; inserted at top if locationID matches the open board.

NEW_FRIEND_MADE.client_handling: Push: adds friendProfile (the other player) unless already a friend; 'You are friends with %@ now.'

NOTIFICATION_LIST.client_handling: Delegate handler is an empty stub; never needed.

ONLINE_FRIENDS_STATUS_LIST.client_handling: Friends listed with status 0 stay 0, other status -> 3; unlisted friends -> 4 (offline).

PLAYER_ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.client_handling: For own playerID this enables achievement awarding for the session.

PLAYER_PROFILE.client_handling: Shown in the open profile view; not matched to the request.

PLAYER_PROFILE_UPDATE.client_handling: Full copy of the self profile after any change (credits, reputation, avatar, location, Facebook link). This is how the server learns currency. No reply.

PLAYER_RANK_RESPONSE.client_handling: Fills the world rank table (spinner 4). responseCode ignored. RankEntity.rankID must be a playerID (row highlight; 0 shows 'Player'), rankIndex is 0-based. playerRank is appended if the target is not in rankList.

PLAYER_RATING_LIST.client_handling: Average stars = sum(rating*numOfRating)/sum(numOfRating). No target ID: replies must follow request order. Also feeds achievements for own profile.

PLAYER_TAP.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

PRODUCT_LIST.client_handling: Handled if pushed (replaces the open store's list) but never requested.

PROFANITY_WORD_ENTITIES.client_handling: Replaces the in-memory profanity list (category 0 substring, other = word boundary).

REMOVE_FRIEND.client_handling: Removes locally first; no reply. Server should push FRIEND_REMOVED to the other player.

REQUEST_LIST.client_handling: Additive (never cleared). type 1 -> friend request UI; type 0 -> IM accept popup, auto-answers RETURN_RESPONSE (1 if blocked, 2 if busy or own status 0); type 3 -> '%@ has poked you.'. Each Request needs requestID, fromPlayerID and the sender's full fromPlayerProfile.

RETURN_RESPONSE.client_handling: Answer to a request: responseCode 0 accept, 1 reject, 2 busy (IM); targetPlayerID = original requester. The client never handles an incoming RETURN_RESPONSE: the server turns it into NEW_FRIEND_MADE / IM_START / IM_BUSY / IM_REJECT pushes.

SEARCH_FB_FRIEND.client_handling: FriendComponent cycle with Facebook friend IDs (name empty).

SEND_MAIL.client_handling: chainID always 0; message = opaque serialized mail content (may include a gift); soundTrack empty unless a clip is attached. Missions also mail the player itself (targetPlayerID = self).
SEND_MAIL.minimal_server_reply: SEND_MAIL_RESPONSE; push NEW_MAIL to the recipient

SEND_MAIL_RESPONSE.client_handling: Ignored if targetplayerID = self. 0 'Mail Sent', 1 'mailbox is full', 2 'Mail fail to send'.

SEND_NOTIFICATION.client_handling: DO NOT SEND: the handler calls Notification selectors on the message object and will throw an unrecognized-selector exception. The client never sends it either.

SEND_REQUEST.client_handling: request.type: 0 IM chat request (isInstance 1), 1 friend request (isInstance 0), 3 poke (isInstance 1, client fills fromPlayerProfile), 2 sent once with target 0 by IMComponent init (unclear; ignore). requestID and fromPlayerProfile are not filled by the client.
SEND_REQUEST.minimal_server_reply: none to the sender; relay to the target as REQUEST_LIST

START_CREW_BATTLE.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

STOP_CREW_BATTLE.client_handling: Crew battle is not wired up in this client.

TOTAL_FIGHT.client_handling: FightConnector compares the type and does nothing.

UPDATE_APARTMENT_DATA.client_handling: Apartment editor SAVE; apartmentID = self apartmentIDList. No reply; store per apartment.
